text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from 18:02 UTC. Affected route: /v1/generate. 5xx rate increased from 0.3% -> 9.8% in last 5m. Region: us-west-2. Triggering pager for oncall.
olivia_sre: oncall, can someone take? looks like LB/Envoy path. paging now @oncall-rotation
oncall-rotation: I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking LB metrics. Any recent deploys or config rollouts? :eyes:
sam_ops: I see a route rollout finished ~17:55 that adjusted retry/circuit_breaker settings for gateway-service. Pulling config diff now.
nina_platform: i can pull envoy stats and cluster health. running `curl -s http://localhost:19090/stats | grep upstream_rq_5xx` on the gateway box
sam_ops: diff from deploy logs:
```
- retry_policy:
-   retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused_stream
-   num_retries: 2
+ retry_policy:
+  retry_on: 5xx,connect
+  num_retries: 3
```
and a circuit_breaker change increasing max_retries in RT cluster.
jao_prod: customer-impact check: which tenants hit the 5xx? querying logs for /v1/generate 5xx by tenant id.
sam_ops: running k8s logs tail against gateway pods and grepping tenant_id. command:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/gateway-api -c envoy --since=10m | grep "5.." | head -n 50
```
sam_ops: quick findings: majority of 5xx are 503 and 504 and correlated with upstream timeout to model-backend-rt pool. latency for upstreams spikes when retries are enabled — getting retry storms.
olivia_sre: that suggests retry policy is amplifying failures. mitigation proposal: revert retry change to previous config (num_retries: 2 and remove retry_on 5xx) OR temporarily disable retries on the problematic route. also reduce circuit breaker thresholds to avoid cascading.
oncall-rotation: agreed. I'm going to disable retries on /v1/generate route to stop amplification. Will apply patch and restart envoy hot-reload.
sam_ops: patch I'm applying (envoy route snippet):
```
- name: /v1/generate
  route:
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: 5xx,connect
      num_retries: 3
+ name: /v1/generate
+  route:
+    retry_policy:
+      retry_on: ""
+      num_retries: 0
```
Applying via `kubectl apply -f gateway-route-patch.yaml` now.
incident-bot: Incident update: change applied by sam_ops at 18:10 UTC. Notifying oncall.
nina_platform: after patch: upstream error rate dropped 60% in first 3 minutes. envoy 5xxs for the route: 9.8% -> 3.6%.
jao_prod: customer-impact quick update: returning to CS — about 12 customers reported elevated errors in last 8m, most are small spike; no major enterprise SLA breaches so far. marking P1->P1 (still investigating).
sam_ops: Also validated that circuit_breaker settings were raised in the rollout; i'm going to roll them back to pre-rollout values. Applying cb rollback now.
```
# example patch command
kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n prod --type merge -p '{"data":{"cb_max_connections":"1000"}}'
```
olivia_sre: once CB rollback completes, we'll monitor for 15m. If stable, we'll leave change and do a proper config revert in next dev cycle. Open action: create PR to pin retry policy for route and add test in canary harness.
oncall-rotation: CB rollback done at 18:18 UTC. Observability: 5xx now 1.1% and trending down. Latency stable.
cust-success-bot: Noted. I'll update the incident page and ping affected customers with a short note: "We observed transient errors impacting /v1/generate; mitigation applied and service is recovering. We're monitoring; follow-up postmortem forthcoming." :memo:
jao_prod: good. creating postmortem draft and adding timeline entries. Also capture the rollout that triggered change (rollout id: r-2026-17-gateway-route-42).
sam_ops: additional fix: adding a guard so retry_on does not include 5xx for routes to RT model backends. PR drafted: #4523. Will add a test to eval harness to simulate backend 502 and assert no retry storms.
nina_platform: monitoring window: keep open for 30m after last recovery. setting alert suppression while we stabilize.
olivia_sre: thanks all. summary: root cause — recent route config increased retries and loosened circuit breakers; that amplified transient upstream timeouts into a fleetwide 5xx spike. Mitigations: disabled retries on affected route, rolled back CB changes, reverted rollout. Impact: 10-15 customers saw errors; no data loss. Next steps: PR to enforce safe retry defaults, add automated canary to route changes, update runbook for retry-induced amplification.
oncall-rotation: handing off to day oncall for follow-up and postmortem. tagging @olivia_sre for lead on write-up.
olivia_sre: I'll own the postmortem. Leaving thread open until 19:00 UTC to confirm stable baseline. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Final note: incident state -> mitigated at 18:26 UTC. Monitoring-only until 19:00 UTC. Logged runbook link: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/retry-amplification>
sam_ops: adding a short log snippet that was suspicious (stacked retries):
```
upstream request failed: timeout
upstream retry triggered (attempt 2)
upstream request failed: timeout
upstream retry triggered (attempt 3)
upstream request failed: upstream_reset
```
jao_prod: thanks everyone. closing temporary page once 30m stable. will coordinate postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT. :calendar:
